howToEdit: Boxes: each entry in nodes has id, title, repo (the small grey line), text, stage (the column) and row (the place in the column, top first), and lists its build units. Wires join a box's side (l or r) to another box's side.

footnote: Percentages come from an audit of each build unit against the code, weighted by its estimate in days. Live counts a unit fully when it is in use, half when it is partly in use.
